title: Register a pool on the NSW Swimming Pool Register
summary: Learn how to register a swimming pool on the NSW Swimming Pool Register, either online or through your local council.
intro:
Swimming pools must be registered. Pool owners can do this online by completing the NSW Swimming Pool Register registration form.

If you prefer, you can pay a fee to your local council and they will register it on your behalf.

how_to_steps.text: Complete and submit the online form.

more_info.text: If you need to check the status of your registration please use the Check Property search on the NSW Swimming Pool Register website.

external_links.text: Pools and pool safety – Building Commission NSW
Find your local council – Office of Local Government

faqs.q: Do I need to register my swimming pool?
faqs.a: Yes, swimming pools must be registered.

faqs.q: How can I register my pool?
faqs.a: You can register online by completing the NSW Swimming Pool Register registration form, or you can pay a fee to your local council to register it on your behalf.

faqs.q: What information do I need to register my pool?
faqs.a: You need the address of your property, details of your pool, details of your pool barrier, and the approximate age of your pool.
